data.one_liner: Implements the Google Geocoding API with default and reverse geosearch.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Dart client for the Google Geocoding API, supporting latitude/longitude lookup, reverse geocoding for address lookups, and place geocoding. It includes an experimental utility method to map results into simplified pretty address objects.
use_when: You need to query Google's Geocoding API in a pure Dart or Flutter environment
You want to convert addresses to coordinates or coordinates to addresses via Google
avoid_when: You are looking for an on-device geocoding or general mapping solution without depending on Google's API services
strengths: Pure Dart dependency with no mandatory Flutter constraints
Easy to use API for standard geocoding, reverse geocoding, and place geocoding
Built-in pretty address mapper for easier data extraction
weaknesses: Requires a valid Google Developer Console API key and relies on a paid external web service
The pretty address mapping feature is marked as experimental
data.setup_notes: Requires obtaining an API key from the Google Developer Console.

alternatives.name: geocoding
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer using platform native geocoding services instead of relying on the Google Geocoding web API.

alternatives.name: geolocator
alternatives.why_pick_it: If your primary requirement is obtaining the current device location rather than querying a geocoding database.
